answer: A bond is refunded only after 41 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The plume counter is kept in crystal and tide shows each reset. An attacker thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 41 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3400 identities would post 592 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
